articles.title: Connection Must Be More Than a Holiday Tradition
articles.summary: It’s Thanksgiving Day. For many of us, this means turkey and stuffing in the oven. Football playing in the background. Family and friends gathering to share a meal . And someone asking: “How about we go around and say what we’re thankful for?” People share stories, discuss milestones, maybe even acknowledge personal challenges. articles.title: ‘Not a Close Case’: Judge Strikes Down Trump Administration’s Targeting of ABC

articles.title: Artists and Fans Pay Tribute to Duran Duran Guitarist Andy Taylor
articles.summary: Fans and fellow artists are paying tribute to Andy Taylor, the guitarist of Duran Duran and a Rock & Roll Hall of Fame inductee, after his death this week at age 65. Taylor died Monday after a yearslong battle with stage 4 metastatic prostate cancer. articles.summary: This article discusses the full second season of The Hunting Wives. The Hunting Wives , whose second season has arrived on Netflix just in time to distract fans from our feasting families, isn’t so different from TV’s dozens of other soapy thrillers on paper.
